messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
By which date must the Commission adopt the delegated acts provided for in Article 6(11) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (common methodology for the data Member States must provide)?

response.text: By what date is the Commission required to adopt the delegated acts referred to in Article 6(11) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which concern the common methodology for the data that Member States must provide?
